scripts.ui: bun -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const dist=path.join('installer', 'dist'); const exe=fs.readdirSync(dist).find(f => f.startsWith('BetterDiscord') && (f.endsWith('.exe') || !f.includes('.'))); if (exe) require('child_process').spawn(path.join(dist, exe), {detached:true, stdio:'ignore'}).unref(); else console.error('Binary not found in installer/dist')"
